svg.metadata: {"batch": 330, "version": "v01", "concept_id": "edu.cloud-form-height-collection-model", "source_model": {"path": "/Users/paulblenkhorn/Documents/Codex/2026-10-22/continue-the-planning-discussion-for-a/work/parallel-tactile/330-author/330-source-model-v03.json", "sha256": "41e147dc6bcffb266b6bb00e2dd7000cc19cadae1a5c05a68a74221b06f1b49f", "bytes": 27370}, "coordinate_evidence": {"path": "/Users/paulblenkhorn/Documents/Codex/2026-10-22/continue-the-planning-discussion-for-a/work/parallel-tactile/330-author/designs/330-coordinates-v01.json", "sha256": "ea3b3d8f70c6ca20e82540d7bc9313633b12940f4639d8b722d22bde27b6f040", "bytes": 9705043}, "nominal_departures": [{"type": "Selected cloud comparison/aerodynamic lesson with introduced semantic conventions", "scope": "ONE bounded comparison containing exactly TEN WMO genera as ten card instances in2columns/5rows, not ten new meanings. Original239data supplied sparse introduced form recipes; exact original447 membership/labels are not recovered. Cards are not literal altitude strata. Each card has three learned ordinal high/middle/low ticks, a span for usual/potential vertical extent and a transverse ROLE marker: usual level association for most genera, explicitly LOW-BASE association for Cumulus/Cumulonimbus. Altostratus usualmiddle may extendhigh; Nimbostratus middleassociation may spanotherlevels, not a universalmiddle cloudbase; Cu/Cb lowbase may developvertically, not every example reachingalllevels. WMOlatitude-dependent ranges overlap and are contextual text, not measured cardinal km, hardceilings or deviceheight. Sparse openwisps/finergrain/largerrolls/veil/striatedlayer/diffuselayer+precip/connectedlowrolls/uniformlowstratus/heap/tower-anvil examples do not alone classify real clouds; optical sheen/opacity/apparentangularsize and natural recognition remain externally taught/evaluated. No WMO photographs used. Relative whole grain8.4mm versus altocumulus ellipse20x14mm is introduced, not apparent-degree measurement or literal cloud count. Ten card outlines/glyphs/materialreference areas are not solid cloud blocks, physical holes or weather prediction. Source239short ticks/spans and grainradius4 are deliberately adjusted BEFORE artwork to retain all primary feature lengths>=12.5mm and feasible1.2mm Indexdot3.1mm centreguards/protected extrema; current role marker distinguishes extent from association. Nominal455x575mm page is illustrative, devicefit/calibration/touch/recognition pending. Pre-art Cu refinement changes one introduced cubic control x135\u2192132 at localy31, eliminating a2.666537mm distinct-extremum/junction pair without dropping protected anchors; detached heap/flatbase semantics unchanged. Pre-art Cb refinement changes first lower-tower cubic control y45\u219246 after localjunction(62,46), removing an adjacent distinct extremum while retaining tower/anvil topology and every guard."}, {"type": "Index graphic line-dot alternative", "scope": "Index1.2mm GRAPHIC LINE DOTS are a declared medium alternative, not Braille or extra cloud elements/flow particles. Whole semantic glyphs, where present, retain their separately checked full native envelopes of at least6mm. Global rounded centres at least3.1mm and each native path interval at most6.2mm; true contacts, corners and native extrema protected. No physical tracing or learner-recognition approval.", "actual_phase_choices": [{"path": "stratocumulus-connected-form", "target_arclength_mm": 82.94874523961931, "effective_arclength_mm": 83.69874523961931, "shift_mm": 0.75, "reason": "Bounded quarter-mm phase trial preserves actual contacts/corners/extrema and global3.1mm rounded-centre guard; curve unchanged."}, {"path": "stratocumulus-connected-form", "target_arclength_mm": 86.63829530783872, "effective_arclength_mm": 86.88829530783872, "shift_mm": 0.25, "reason": "Bounded quarter-mm phase trial preserves actual contacts/corners/extrema and global3.1mm rounded-centre guard; curve unchanged."}, {"path": "stratocumulus-connected-form", "unfilled_target_arclength_mm": 200.55500787743222, "reason": "No tested quarter-mm phase met guard; actual interval requires separate feasibility check."}, {"path": "cumulus-connected-form", "unfilled_target_arclength_mm": 51.192661094191536, "reason": "No tested quarter-mm phase met guard; actual interval requires separate feasibility check."}]}], "source_limit": "ONE bounded comparison containing exactly TEN WMO genera as ten card instances in2columns/5rows, not ten new meanings. Original239data supplied sparse introduced form recipes; exact original447 membership/labels are not recovered. Cards are not literal altitude strata. Each card has three learned ordinal high/middle/low ticks, a span for usual/potential vertical extent and a transverse ROLE marker: usual level association for most genera, explicitly LOW-BASE association for Cumulus/Cumulonimbus. Altostratus usualmiddle may extendhigh; Nimbostratus middleassociation may spanotherlevels, not a universalmiddle cloudbase; Cu/Cb lowbase may developvertically, not every example reachingalllevels. WMOlatitude-dependent ranges overlap and are contextual text, not measured cardinal km, hardceilings or deviceheight. Sparse openwisps/finergrain/largerrolls/veil/striatedlayer/diffuselayer+precip/connectedlowrolls/uniformlowstratus/heap/tower-anvil examples do not alone classify real clouds; optical sheen/opacity/apparentangularsize and natural recognition remain externally taught/evaluated. No WMO photographs used. Relative whole grain8.4mm versus altocumulus ellipse20x14mm is introduced, not apparent-degree measurement or literal cloud count. Ten card outlines/glyphs/materialreference areas are not solid cloud blocks, physical holes or weather prediction. Source239short ticks/spans and grainradius4 are deliberately adjusted BEFORE artwork to retain all primary feature lengths>=12.5mm and feasible1.2mm Indexdot3.1mm centreguards/protected extrema; current role marker distinguishes extent from association. Nominal455x575mm page is illustrative, devicefit/calibration/touch/recognition pending. Pre-art Cu refinement changes one introduced cubic control x135\u2192132 at localy31, eliminating a2.666537mm distinct-extremum/junction pair without dropping protected anchors; detached heap/flatbase semantics unchanged. Pre-art Cb refinement changes first lower-tower cubic control y45\u219246 after localjunction(62,46), removing an adjacent distinct extremum while retaining tower/anvil topology and every guard. Illustrative nominal455x575mm page; device/page fit, touch and recognition remain pending.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Index1.2mm GRAPHIC LINE DOTS are a declared medium alternative, not Braille or extra cloud elements/flow particles. Whole semantic glyphs, where present, retain their separately checked full native envelopes of at least6mm. Global rounded centres at least3.1mm and each native path interval at most6.2mm; true contacts, corners and native extrema protected. No physical tracing or learner-recognition approval.
